description: Statewide rollout of AI-powered tools set to enhance Telugu and math education
body_lead: Statewide rollout of AI-powered tools set to enhance Telugu and math education Hyderabad: Artificial intelligence is strengthening government school students' learning abilities in Telugu and mathematics. The FLN-AI (AXL) initiative, which began as a pilot in six districts, will now be expanded across the state as computer-based learning methods will be introduced to primary schools.
